description: Whether a DRAFT election in the connected account can publish now: the checks the publish button runs (schedule, ballot, voter list, state rules, size), each blocker in the words publish would refuse with, warnings a board should hear (voting closes inside the state's notice period, no quorum on an HOA or condo, voters the emailed ballot cannot reach), the exact price and who pays it. Fixing one blocker can show the next, so ask again after each fix. Changes nothing.
